userAccountControl==514,"ACCOUNT_DISABLED", userAccountControl==544,"PASSWD_NOTREQD", userAccountControl==546,"DISABLED_PASSWD_NOTREQD", userAccountControl==66048,"NORMAL_DONT_EXPIRE", userAccountControl==262656,"SMARTCARD_REQUIRED", userAccountControl==4194304,"DONT_REQUIRE_PREAUTH (AS-REP Roastable)", userAccountControl==524288,"TRUSTED_FOR_DELEGATION", true(), tostring(userAccountControl)) | eval primaryGroupID_desc = case(primaryGroupID==512,"Domain Admins", primaryGroupID==513,"Domain Users", primaryGroupID==514,"Domain Guests", primaryGroupID==515,"Domain Computers", primaryGroupID==516,"Domain Controllers", primaryGroupID==518,"Schema Admins", primaryGroupID==519,"Enterprise Admins", primaryGroupID==520,"Group Policy Creators", primaryGroupID==521,"Read-only DCs", primaryGroupID==525,"Protected Users", true(), tostring(primaryGroupID)) | eval msExchRecipientTypeDetails_desc = case(msExchRecipientTypeDetails==1,"UserMailbox", msExchRecipientTypeDetails==2,"MailUser", msExchRecipientTypeDetails==4,"MailContact", msExchRecipientTypeDetails==8,"MailGroup", msExchRecipientTypeDetails==16,"RoomMailbox", msExchRecipientTypeDetails==32,"EquipmentMailbox", msExchRecipientTypeDetails==128,"LinkedMailbox", msExchRecipientTypeDetails==256,"SharedMailbox", msExchRecipientTypeDetails==2048,"GroupMailbox", msExchRecipientTypeDetails==2147483648,"ArbitrationMailbox", true(), tostring(msExchRecipientTypeDetails)) | eval msExchUserAccountControl_desc = case(msExchUserAccountControl==0,"NO_FLAGS (Enabled)", msExchUserAccountControl==1,"ACCOUNT_DISABLED", msExchUserAccountControl==2,"MAPI_ENABLED", msExchUserAccountControl==4,"OWA_ENABLED", msExchUserAccountControl==8,"ACTIVESYNC_ENABLED", msExchUserAccountControl==16,"IMAP_ENABLED", msExchUserAccountControl==32,"POP_ENABLED", msExchUserAccountControl==64,"UM_ENABLED", true(), tostring(msExchUserAccountControl)) | eval msExchELCMailboxFlags_desc = case(msExchELCMailboxFlags==0,"NO_HOLD", msExchELCMailboxFlags==2,"RETENTION_HOLD", msExchELCMailboxFlags==128,"LITIGATION_HOLD", msExchELCMailboxFlags==130,"LITIGATION_HOLD + RETENTION_HOLD", msExchELCMailboxFlags==256,"IN_PLACE_HOLD", msExchELCMailboxFlags==512,"SITE_MAILBOX", true(), tostring(msExchELCMailboxFlags)) | eval accountExpires_desc = if(accountExpires=="(never)" OR accountExpires=="9223372036854775807", "Never", accountExpires) | eval msRTCSIP_UserEnabled_desc = if('msRTCSIP-UserEnabled'==1, "Enabled", "Disabled") | eval msExchMailboxAuditEnable_desc = if(msExchMailboxAuditEnable==1, "Enabled (Auditing ON)", "Disabled (Auditing OFF)") | eval msRTCSIP_InternetAccessEnabled_desc = if('msRTCSIP-InternetAccessEnabled'==1, "Enabled", "Disabled") | eval sIDHistory_Status = if(isnull(sIDHistory) OR sIDHistory=="[]" OR sIDHistory=="", "✅ CLEAN (Empty)", "🚨 POPULATED - INVESTIGATE IMMEDIATELY") | eval msDS_KeyCredentialLink_Status = if(isnull('msDS-KeyCredentialLink') OR 'msDS-KeyCredentialLink'=="[]" OR 'msDS-KeyCredentialLink'=="", "✅ CLEAN (Empty)", "🚨 SHADOW CREDENTIALS DETECTED") | eval msDS_AllowedToDelegateTo_Status = if(isnull('msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo') OR 'msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo'=="[]" OR 'msDS-AllowedToDelegateTo'=="", "✅ CLEAN (Empty)", "⚠️ POPULATED - DELEGATION MISCONFIG") | rename "userAccountControl_desc" AS "UAC (Decoded)", "primaryGroupID_desc" AS "Primary Group (Decoded)", "msExchRecipientTypeDetails_desc" AS "Mailbox Type", "msExchUserAccountControl_desc" AS "Exchange UAC (Decoded)", "msExchELCMailboxFlags_desc" AS "Hold / Retention Flags", "accountExpires_desc" AS "Account Expires", "msRTCSIP_UserEnabled_desc" AS "Teams/Skype Enabled", "msExchMailboxAuditEnable_desc" AS "Mailbox Auditing", "msRTCSIP_InternetAccessEnabled_desc" AS "Teams External Access" | table distinguishedName, sAMAccountName, displayName, givenName, sn, mail, title, employeeID, company, "UAC (Decoded)", "Primary Group (Decoded)", "Mailbox Type", "Exchange UAC (Decoded)", "Hold / Retention Flags", "Account Expires", "Teams/Skype Enabled", "Mailbox Auditing", "Teams External Access", lastLogon, lastLogonTimestamp, logonCount, badPwdCount, badPasswordTime, pwdLastSet, whenCreated, whenChanged, memberOf, objectSid, objectGUID, sIDHistory_Status, msDS_KeyCredentialLink_Status, msDS_AllowedToDelegateTo_Status, msExchHomeServerName, msExchArchiveQuota, msExchArchiveWarnQuota, description, telephoneNumber, mobile, msExchMDBRulesQuota, msExchMobileMailboxFlags, protocolSettings, msExchMailboxAuditLastAdminAccess, msExchWhenMailboxCreated, msDS-LastKnownRDN, uSNCreated, uSNChanged | transpose | rename "column" AS "Attribute", "row 1" AS "Value" | search Value!="[]" AND Value!="null" AND Value!="NULL" AND Value!="" AND Value!="None"

userAccountControl==532480,"DOMAIN_CTRL_TRUST", true(), tostring(userAccountControl)) | eval primaryGroupID_desc = case(primaryGroupID==512,"Domain Admins", primaryGroupID==513,"Domain Users", primaryGroupID==515,"Domain Computers", primaryGroupID==516,"Domain Controllers", true(), tostring(primaryGroupID)) | eval msDS_SupportedEncryptionTypes_desc = case(msDS-SupportedEncryptionTypes==0,"None", msDS-SupportedEncryptionTypes==1,"DES (Weak)", msDS-SupportedEncryptionTypes==4,"AES128", msDS-SupportedEncryptionTypes==8,"AES256", msDS-SupportedEncryptionTypes==24,"AES128+AES256 (Secure)", true(), tostring(msDS-SupportedEncryptionTypes)) | eval ms_Mcs_AdmPwdExpirationTime_desc = if(isnull('ms-Mcs-AdmPwdExpirationTime') OR 'ms-Mcs-AdmPwdExpirationTime'=="0", "⚠️ LAPS Not Configured/Expired", strftime('ms-Mcs-AdmPwdExpirationTime', "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")) | eval msExchMailboxAuditEnable_desc = if(msExchMailboxAuditEnable==1, "Enabled", "Disabled") | eval sIDHistory_Status = if(isnull(sIDHistory) OR sIDHistory=="[]", "✅ CLEAN", "🚨 SID HISTORY FOUND") | eval msDS_KeyCredentialLink_Status =
